AAPL.thesis: Record Q1 revenue $143.8B (16% YoY) with iPhone $85.3B all-time high and Services $30B. Privacy-first AI approach via Apple Intelligence, but monetization slower than peers.
AAPL.recent: Q1 FY2026 EPS $2.84 (19% YoY); iPhone revenue $85.3B (+23% YoY); Services $30B (+14% YoY).
AAPL.risk: iPhone upgrade cycle potentially peaking; Apple Intelligence adoption slower than expected; regulatory pressure on App Store.
AAPL.watch: Siri integration with next-gen foundation models; Apple Intelligence feature rollout; Services revenue sustainability.

MSFT.thesis: $625B commercial backlog (45% OpenAI-tied) with Azure growth 39%. Capex surged 66% to $37.5B in Q2 FY2026 — investors demanding near-term ROI proof.
MSFT.recent: Q2 FY2026 revenue $81.27B; Azure growth 39%; capex increased 66% for AI infrastructure. Stock down 14.4% post-earnings.
MSFT.risk: ROI timeline on massive AI capex uncertain; concentrated backlog with OpenAI creates execution risk.
MSFT.watch: Azure AI revenue acceleration; capex efficiency and data center utilization; Copilot adoption and pricing power.

GOOGL.thesis: Cloud $17.7B (48% YoY) with backlog doubled to $240B. Gemini 750M MAUs with serving costs down 78% in 2025. But $175-185B capex guidance for 2026 rattled investors.
GOOGL.recent: Q4 2025 revenue +18% YoY; Cloud revenue $17.7B (48% YoY); Gemini 750M MAUs; stock fell 3% despite revenue beat.
GOOGL.risk: Massive capex increase with uncertain ROI; search facing AI-driven disruption; antitrust regulatory overhang.
GOOGL.watch: Cloud revenue momentum and AI workload mix; Gemini monetization progress; capex efficiency vs. MSFT and AMZN.

META.thesis: FY2025 revenue $200.97B (22% YoY). Delivering operating income growth despite $115-135B 2026 capex. Reality Labs lost $20B in 2025 with no clear path to profitability.
META.recent: Q4 $22.77B net income (9% YoY); 2026 capex guidance $115-135B (up from $72B in 2025).
META.risk: AI capex ROI unclear; ad efficiency gains may hit ceiling; Reality Labs continues $20B+ annual burn.
META.watch: Llama 4.5 launch H1 2026; WhatsApp monetization ramp; AI-driven ad performance vs. capex spend.

AMZN.thesis: AWS backlog $244B (40% YoY). $200B capex plan for 2026 unlocks capacity-constrained AI workloads. AWS growth 19% YoY amid constraints — should accelerate H2.
AMZN.recent: Q4 2024 revenue $187.8B (10% YoY); AWS $28.8B (19% YoY); operating income up 48%.
AMZN.risk: ROI on $200B capex uncertain; retail margin pressure; AWS growth deceleration if capacity doesn't unlock revenue.
AMZN.watch: H2 2026 AWS acceleration as new data centers come online; AI workload monetization vs. non-AI growth.

NVDA.thesis: Blackwell ramp fastest in history — 70% of Q4 data center revenue. $500B+ purchase commitments through 2026. But China revenue fell $4B due to export controls.
NVDA.recent: Data center revenue up 73% YoY; B300 mid-cycle refresh on track for H2 2026.
NVDA.risk: Hyperscaler capex moderation or export restrictions could derail growth.
NVDA.watch: B300 (Blackwell Ultra) launch H2 2026; sustained hyperscaler capex above $3-4T annual AI infrastructure.

AMD.thesis: MI300 series delivered $5B+ data center AI revenue in 2024 (94% YoY growth). But Q4 data center $3.86B missed by $280M — raising GPU competitiveness concerns vs. NVIDIA.
AMD.recent: Q4 2024 revenue $7.7B; data center up 69% YoY to $3.9B but missed expectations.
AMD.risk: Continued competitive pressure from NVIDIA; potential margin compression from aggressive pricing.
AMD.watch: MI350 ramp in H2 2026; data center revenue growth vs. NVIDIA's Blackwell adoption.

INTC.thesis: 18A yields improving 7%/month hitting 65-75% range. Apple joined as first major external customer for entry-level chips. Still losing share in core PC/server to AMD.
INTC.recent: 18A in high-volume manufacturing with Panther Lake ramping; external customer commitments delayed to H2 2026.
INTC.risk: Execution risk on 18A yields; TSMC N2 and Samsung 2nm could limit foundry share.
INTC.watch: External foundry customer announcements H2 2026; Apple chip volume ramp vs. TSMC N2.

AVGO.thesis: AI revenue doubled to $8.2B in Q1 FY2026 from custom AI accelerators and Ethernet switches. Diversified across semiconductors and software (47% YoY growth).
AVGO.recent: Q1 FY2025 revenue $14.92B (25% YoY); AI revenue $4.1B (77% YoY); software sales up 47%.
AVGO.risk: Concentration risk in top hyperscaler customers; AI infrastructure spending slowdown could pressure margins.
AVGO.watch: AI revenue trajectory toward full-year target; customer diversification beyond top 3 hyperscalers.

TSM.thesis: Monopoly on advanced node manufacturing (3nm/2nm). AI chip demand driving record capacity utilization. $40B+ Arizona fab investment for geopolitical hedging.
TSM.recent: Record revenue driven by AI chip demand; 3nm yields above expectations; Arizona fab on track.
TSM.risk: Geopolitical Taiwan risk; customer concentration (AAPL + NVDA = ~35% revenue); cyclical demand risk.
TSM.watch: 2nm ramp timeline; Arizona fab production start; China export control impact on utilization.

MU.thesis: HBM TAM growing 40% CAGR to $100B by 2028 — entire 2026 supply sold out. Industry-leading HBM4 ramping Q2 2026. Elevated $20B FY2026 capex.
MU.recent: Q1 FY2026 revenue $13.64B (57% YoY) with 37% gross margin; Q2 guidance $18.7B revenue and 68% gross margin.
MU.risk: HBM supply-demand imbalance could emerge in 2027+ if competitors ramp capacity faster.
MU.watch: HBM4 production yields at major AI chip customers; gross margin trajectory toward 68%.

MCHP.thesis: Inventory normalization complete with exceptionally strong backlog and bookings. 15-20% organic revenue growth guided for FY2026. Still unprofitable on GAAP basis.
MCHP.recent: Q3 FY2026 revenue $1.19B (15.6% YoY); EPS $0.44 beat by $0.02; backlog $1.41B.
MCHP.risk: Cyclical automotive and industrial exposure; margin pressure from capacity expansion.
MCHP.watch: Turbojet engine production contracts Q2-Q3 2026; backlog conversion rate.

ASML.thesis: EUV monopoly with $7.1B Q4 bookings ($3B EUV). Raised FY2026 guidance to €34-39B revenue with 51-53% gross margin. Announced €12B buyback.
ASML.recent: FY2025 revenue €32B with EUV sales up 39% to €11.6B.
ASML.risk: Export controls to China; semiconductor oversupply if AI capex slows.
ASML.watch: High-NA EUV adoption timeline; sub-3nm node delivery schedules in 2026-27.

PLTR.thesis: AIP platform drove U.S. commercial revenue up 64% YoY to $214M. Nearly 5x customer count vs. 3 years ago. But 40x+ sales valuation demands perfection.
PLTR.recent: Q4 2024 revenue $827.5M (36% YoY); U.S. commercial up 64%; gross margin 78.9%.
PLTR.risk: Valuation at 40x+ sales; slowdown in commercial adds or government budget cuts pressure growth.
PLTR.watch: AIP adoption metrics and bootcamp-to-paid conversion rates; international expansion progress.

SMCI.thesis: Q2 FY2026 revenue $12.68B (100%+ YoY) smashed estimates. Raised full-year guidance to $40B+. But margins declining and customer concentration risk remains.
SMCI.recent: Q2 FY2026 revenue $12.68B beat consensus $10.43B; Q3 guidance $12.3B revenue.
SMCI.risk: Margin compression from pricing competition; high customer concentration in AI infrastructure.
SMCI.watch: Liquid cooling adoption trajectory; market share defense as Dell/HPE ramp AI servers.

CRWV.thesis: Contracted revenue backlog exceeds $55B (vs. market cap). 90%+ YoY growth targeting $10B+ revenue in 2026. Aggressive capex doubling burns cash before profitability.
CRWV.recent: Revenue backlog exceeded $55B as of Sept 2025; next earnings Feb 18, 2026.
CRWV.risk: Cash burn and need for additional capital raises; customer concentration; reliance on AI compute demand.
CRWV.watch: Execution on doubling capex in 2026; backlog-to-revenue conversion; GPU supply chain constraints.

QBTS.thesis: Only company building both annealing and gate-model quantum. Cash $836M provides runway. But revenue only $3.7M/quarter — profitability years away.
QBTS.recent: Q3 2025 revenue $3.7M (100% YoY); YTD 9-month revenue $21.8M (235% YoY).
QBTS.risk: Commercial viability timeline uncertain; cash burn could require dilution before revenue scales.
QBTS.watch: Commercial customer conversion from pilots to production; gate-model competitive positioning.

RGTI.thesis: Secured $8.4M India order for 108-qubit system. Roadmap targets 1,000+ qubits by 2027. Q3 revenue $1.9M (-18% YoY) with $20.5M operating loss.
RGTI.recent: Q3 2025 revenue $1.9M (-18% YoY); $5.7M in new Novera orders for H1 2026 delivery.
RGTI.risk: Execution risk on qubit roadmap; $8.4B valuation requires flawless execution; profitability 4-5 years away.
RGTI.watch: 100+ qubit chiplet delivery and 150+ qubit system by end-2026; fidelity improvements to 99.7%.

IONQ.thesis: Q3 revenue $39.9M (222% YoY); raised FY2025 to $106-110M. Achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity. But P/S >150x with operating costs 7x revenue.
IONQ.recent: Q3 2025 revenue $39.9M (222% YoY); raised guidance; AQ 64 fidelity milestone.
IONQ.risk: Valuation priced for perfection; profitability years away; cash burn with operating costs 7x revenue.
IONQ.watch: 256-qubit system integration (Oxford Ionics architecture); government/defense contract wins.

RKLB.thesis: Q3 revenue $155M (48% YoY) with record 37% gross margin and 49 launches on backlog. Neutron critical tank rupture threatens mid-2026 launch timeline.
RKLB.recent: Q3 2025 revenue $155M (48% YoY); Q4 guidance $170-180M with 37-39% margins.
RKLB.risk: Neutron launch delays beyond Q2 2026 could erode confidence; Electron capacity constraints.
RKLB.watch: Neutron tank testing results and revised launch timeline; Electron cadence ramp.

ASTS.thesis: BlueBird 6 (2,400 sq ft, 10x capacity) launched Dec 2025 at 120 Mbps. Targeting 45-60 satellites by end-2026. Cash burn significant before commercial service.
ASTS.recent: BlueBird 6 successfully launched Dec 2025; 10x capacity vs. prior satellites.
ASTS.risk: Satellite deployment delays or technical failures; capital requirements for full constellation.
ASTS.watch: Launch cadence of 1-2 satellites/month through 2026; commercial service activation timeline.

LUNR.thesis: Leading lunar lander company with NASA CLPS contracts. IM-2 mission scheduled for 2026 with multiple payloads. Revenue lumpy and mission-dependent.
LUNR.recent: IM-2 mission preparations underway; multiple NASA and commercial payload contracts secured.
LUNR.risk: Mission failure risk; lumpy revenue tied to launch cadence; competitive pressure from SpaceX and others.
LUNR.watch: IM-2 mission success; follow-on CLPS contract awards; commercial payload pipeline.

RDW.thesis: Space infrastructure provider with growing on-orbit servicing capabilities. Revenue growing but profitability remains elusive with heavy R&D investment.
RDW.recent: Multiple on-orbit assembly and manufacturing contracts; expanding capabilities in space infrastructure.
RDW.risk: Small revenue base; execution risk on complex space hardware; government budget dependency.
RDW.watch: On-orbit demonstration missions; contract win rate; path to positive EBITDA.

KTOS.thesis: Valkyrie drone became Marines program of record. Backlog $1.41B with 15-20% organic growth guided for FY2026-27. Trades at 800x trailing earnings.
KTOS.recent: Q3 2025 revenue $347.6M; backlog $1.41B; guided 15-20% FY2026 and 18-23% FY2027 growth.
KTOS.risk: Profitability timeline uncertain; cash burn from facility expansion; high valuation vs. earnings.
KTOS.watch: Turbojet engine production contracts Q2-Q3 2026; backlog conversion and EBITDA margin expansion ~100bps.

LMT.thesis: Record $194B backlog; 25%+ YoY operating profit growth expected in 2026. Delivered 191 F-35s and 120 PAC-3 interceptors (both records).
LMT.recent: Guided ~5% revenue growth in 2026 with $6.5-6.8B FCF; 35% YoY capex increase.
LMT.risk: Government budget cuts or slowdown in international orders; supply chain and labor constraints.
LMT.watch: F-35 production ramp and international orders; missile defense expansion across 5 states.

GE.thesis: LEAP and GEnx engines sold out through end of decade. Targeting ~2,000 LEAP deliveries in 2026 with 27% revenue growth.
GE.recent: Q3 2025 revenue $11.3B (26% YoY); EPS $1.66 (14% beat); raised FY EPS to $6.00-6.20.
GE.risk: Supply chain constraints limiting engine deliveries; cyclical exposure to air travel demand.
GE.watch: LEAP delivery ramp toward 2,000 units; Commercial Engines & Services growth vs. Defense segment.

TSLA.thesis: FSD unsupervised launching Austin June 2025. $2B xAI investment signals AI leadership. But first annual delivery decline (1.8M units) with margin at 6.2%.
TSLA.recent: Q4 deliveries 495K; FY 1.8M (first annual decline); FSD unsupervised service launching Austin June 2025.
TSLA.risk: FSD regulatory approval delays; EV demand slowdown; intensifying competition from BYD and legacy OEMs.
TSLA.watch: Austin FSD launch success and regulatory expansion; operating margin trajectory; 2026 delivery guidance.

RIVN.thesis: R2 SUV targets mass market at $45K starting 2026. VW joint venture provides $5.8B in funding. But burning $1.5B+ cash/quarter with negative margins.
RIVN.recent: R2 production preparations at Normal, IL factory; VW partnership delivering software synergies.
RIVN.risk: Cash burn rate; R2 production ramp execution; competitive EV pricing pressure.
RIVN.watch: R2 production start and reservation-to-order conversion; gross margin trajectory toward breakeven.

LCID.thesis: Gravity SUV launched late 2025 at $79,900. PIF backing provides capital runway. Technology leadership (500+ mile range) but minimal deliveries.
LCID.recent: Gravity SUV deliveries began; expanding production capacity at Arizona factory.
LCID.risk: Low production volumes; heavy cash burn; luxury EV market saturation.
LCID.watch: Gravity delivery ramp; production efficiency improvements; path to positive gross margin.

QS.thesis: Eagle Line pilot facility inaugurating Feb 2026. QSE-5 enables 500+ mile range with 15-min charging. But 2026 revenue only $4M — profitability years away.
QS.recent: Eagle Line facility launching Feb 2026; cash $797.5M; PowerCo expanded collaboration with $131M milestones.
QS.risk: Manufacturing scale-up execution; Toyota 2027-28 solid-state timeline and BYD cost advantages.
QS.watch: Eagle Line pilot yields and production metrics; commercial battery shipments; competitor timelines.

ARRY.thesis: Raised FY2025 guidance to $1.25-1.28B revenue with $185-195M EBITDA. $1.9B backlog mostly domestic. ITC expiration end-2025 creates 2026 demand cliff.
ARRY.recent: Q3 revenue and volume up 70% and 56% YoY; backlog $1.9B; raised full-year guidance.
ARRY.risk: Solar ITC expiration creates 2026 headwind; trade policy uncertainty; project execution risks.
ARRY.watch: Q4 FY2025 earnings Feb 25 with 2026 guidance; ITC extensions; EPC contract wins or cancellations.

ENPH.thesis: Micro-inverter market leader facing severe demand downturn. IQ8 transition and battery attach rates key. Residential solar install rates recovering slowly.
ENPH.recent: Revenue declining amid solar installation slowdown; inventory normalization ongoing.
ENPH.risk: Prolonged residential solar downturn; market share loss to cheaper string inverters; policy uncertainty.
ENPH.watch: Quarterly install rate recovery; IQ8 adoption; battery storage attach rate trends.

SQ.thesis: Block (Cash App + Square) ecosystem serving 57M+ monthly transacting actives. Profitable but growth decelerating. Bitcoin holdings add volatility.
SQ.recent: Cash App ecosystem growing; Square GPV recovering; Bitcoin strategy ongoing.
SQ.risk: Fintech competition from PayPal, Apple Pay; consumer spending slowdown; Bitcoin exposure.
SQ.watch: Cash App monetization per user; Square seller growth; gross profit growth acceleration.

COIN.thesis: Leading U.S. crypto exchange positioned for institutional adoption. Spot Bitcoin ETFs drove record volumes. Revenue highly correlated to crypto prices.
COIN.recent: Benefiting from spot BTC and ETH ETF launches; regulatory environment improving.
COIN.risk: Crypto bear market decimates volumes; regulatory uncertainty; competition from Robinhood and traditional brokers.
COIN.watch: Institutional adoption metrics; crypto ETF volume sustainability; staking and other services.

HOOD.thesis: Robinhood expanding beyond trading into wealth management and crypto. 24M funded accounts with growing ARPU. Crypto revenue volatile but meaningful.
HOOD.recent: Record revenue and profitability; crypto trading surging; launching new financial products.
HOOD.risk: Revenue concentration in volatile crypto trading; regulatory risk; competition from established brokers.
HOOD.watch: ARPU growth trajectory; wealth management product adoption; crypto revenue durability.

SOFI.thesis: Full-stack digital bank with lending, investing, and banking products. 10M+ members growing. Path to sustained profitability through cross-selling.
SOFI.recent: Member growth accelerating; lending volumes recovering; banking deposits growing.
SOFI.risk: Credit quality deterioration if economy weakens; student loan policy changes; interest rate sensitivity.
SOFI.watch: Member growth and cross-sell metrics; credit performance; net interest margin trajectory.

MRNA.thesis: mRNA platform beyond COVID: RSV vaccine approved, cancer vaccines in Phase 3. $9B+ cash. But COVID revenue collapsed and pipeline execution is critical.
MRNA.recent: RSV vaccine Mresvia gaining market share; cancer vaccine mRNA-4157 in pivotal trials.
MRNA.risk: Pipeline failure risk; COVID revenue continued decline; competition from Pfizer and GSK.
MRNA.watch: Cancer vaccine Phase 3 readouts; RSV market share vs. GSK/Pfizer; pipeline milestones.

CRSP.thesis: Casgevy (gene therapy for SCD/beta-thal) approved and launching. First CRISPR-based therapy on market. Revenue ramp is key question.
CRSP.recent: Casgevy treatment centers expanding; first commercial patients treated.
CRSP.risk: Slow patient enrollment; high treatment costs limiting adoption; competition from bluebird bio.
CRSP.watch: Casgevy patient starts and treatment center expansion; pipeline advancement; revenue ramp.

NET.thesis: Cloudflare expanding from CDN to full cloud platform. 35%+ revenue growth with improving margins. Developer-first approach gaining enterprise traction.
NET.recent: Revenue growth ~30% YoY; enterprise customer adds accelerating; AI workload opportunities emerging.
NET.risk: Competition from AWS/Azure/GCP; enterprise sales cycle elongation; valuation premium.
NET.watch: Enterprise customer growth rate; AI-related product adoption; operating margin expansion.

SNOW.thesis: Data cloud platform with growing AI/ML workloads. Product revenue growth ~25% but decelerating. Cortex AI features driving new use cases.
SNOW.recent: Product revenue growth stabilizing; Cortex AI and Snowpark driving engagement.
SNOW.risk: Growth deceleration; competition from Databricks; consumption model sensitivity to macro.
SNOW.watch: Product revenue growth reacceleration; Cortex AI adoption; net revenue retention rate.

DDOG.thesis: Observability platform expanding into security and AI monitoring. 30%+ revenue growth with best-in-class retention. AI workload monitoring is emerging catalyst.
DDOG.recent: Strong enterprise adoption; AI monitoring products gaining traction; expanding product portfolio.
DDOG.risk: Competitive pressure from Splunk (Cisco), New Relic; enterprise spending rationalization.
DDOG.watch: AI monitoring product adoption; enterprise deal sizes; operating margin expansion.

DIS.thesis: Streaming profitable at $450M Q1 operating income (72% YoY). ESPN/NFL partnership with 10% equity stake unlocks monetization. Linear TV decline continues.
DIS.recent: Q1 2026 sports revenue $4.91B but operating income -23% YoY due to YouTube TV dispute.
DIS.risk: Linear TV deteriorating; streaming competition; sports rights costs escalating faster than revenue.
DIS.watch: ESPN Unlimited subscriber adoption; streaming margin toward 10% FY2026 target.

SPOT.thesis: 281M subscribers (12% YoY), 713M MAUs. Operating income $582M with 31.6% gross margin. Shifting to margin expansion focus.
SPOT.recent: Q3 2025 revenue €4.3B (12% cc); Q4 guidance 289M subscribers and €4.5B revenue.
SPOT.risk: Music licensing cost inflation; competition from Apple Music and YouTube Music.
SPOT.watch: Q4 2025 earnings Feb 10; audiobook/podcast monetization; margin expansion trajectory.

CHWY.thesis: One-third online pet supply share (matching Amazon). $600 annual revenue per loyal customer. Forward P/E only 22x. But net margin compressed to 1.6%.
CHWY.recent: Q3 FY2026 revenue $3.1B (8.3% YoY); $59.2M net income ($0.14 EPS).
CHWY.risk: Margin compression from Amazon/Walmart competition; pet spending slowdown.
CHWY.watch: Net margin trajectory back toward 3-4%; customer retention; competitive pricing dynamics.

AMC.thesis: Refinanced $223M 2026 debt and converted $337M to equity. No annual profit since 2018. Box office still 29% below 2019 levels.
AMC.recent: Refinancing completed; Q4 FY2025 earnings scheduled Feb 24, 2026.
AMC.risk: Structural decline in theatrical attendance; streaming competition; sustained unprofitability.
AMC.watch: Feb 24 earnings; full-year 2025 profitability; box office recovery vs. 2019 baseline.

DJT.thesis: Diversifying beyond Truth Social into investment products, crypto tokens, and $6B+ TAE merger. Limited revenue with ongoing losses.
DJT.recent: Launched Truth Social-branded SMAs and digital token airdrop (Feb 2 record date); $6B+ all-stock TAE merger signed.
DJT.risk: Revenue generation unproven; TAE merger execution risk; political event risk.
DJT.watch: TAE merger closing mid-2026; Truth Predict platform traction; token engagement metrics.

AEO.thesis: Q3 record revenue $1.36B (6% YoY) with EPS $0.53 beating by $0.10. 2.2% dividend yield. But facing $50M tariff headwind in Q4.
AEO.recent: Q3 2025 revenue $1.36B (6% YoY); $20M tariff impact Q3, expecting $50M Q4.
AEO.risk: Tariff costs escalating faster than pricing power; gross margin compression.
AEO.watch: Q4 earnings and guidance; tariff cost pass-through ability; market share vs. fast fashion.

GME.thesis: $9B cash and securities plus $519M Bitcoin. Collectibles revenue up 54.6% YoY. But core hardware -31.7% and software -26.7%. Wall Street consensus 'Sell' at $13.50.
GME.recent: Q3 2025 EPS $0.24 (beat 33%); cash $9B (up from $4.6B YoY); YTD FCF $410M.
GME.risk: Core gaming sales declining; reliance on volatile crypto holdings; turnaround strategy unclear.
GME.watch: Collectibles segment momentum; Bitcoin holdings management; core gaming stabilization.

CBRL.thesis: Implementing $20-25M G&A cuts and $12-16M advertising cuts. EBITDA guidance slashed to $70-110M from $150-190M. Traffic down 8-10% expected FY2026.
CBRL.recent: Q1 FY2026 revenue $797.2M (-5.7% YoY); adjusted EBITDA $7.2M (0.9% margin).
CBRL.risk: Structural traffic decline in casual dining; cost cuts could degrade guest experience.
CBRL.watch: March 3 earnings; traffic trends vs. -8 to -10% guidance; cost reduction effectiveness.

CAVA.thesis: 16%+ unit growth guided for 2026 with low-to-mid single-digit SSS. Restaurant-level profit margin 24.6%. Nearly 5x customer count growth.
CAVA.recent: Q3 2025 adjusted EBITDA $40M (13.7% margin, up 19.6% YoY); restaurant-level margin 24.6%.
CAVA.risk: Unit growth execution; tariff-driven food cost inflation; competitive Mediterranean fast-casual.
CAVA.watch: Feb 24 Q4 earnings with 2026 guidance; restaurant-level margin trajectory; menu pricing power.

TSCO.thesis: Guided 4-6% revenue growth for 2026 with 1-3% comps. Operating margin 9.3-9.6%. Tariffs and transportation crimped margins; inventory up 5%/store.
TSCO.recent: FY2025 sales $15.52B; FY2026 guidance $16.1-16.5B revenue with EPS $2.13-2.23.
TSCO.risk: Tariff-related cost inflation; rural consumer spending sensitivity; inventory challenges.
TSCO.watch: Quarterly comp trends; gross margin expansion H2 2026; new store openings.

LULU.thesis: Trading at 12x forward earnings despite global brand awareness in single-digits outside NA. China expansion opportunity. Q4 guidance disappointed (-14% stock decline).
LULU.recent: Updated guidance at ICR Conference Jan 2026; JPMorgan raised Q4 EPS but guidance underwhelmed.
LULU.risk: U.S. consumer pushback on pricing; athleisure competition; tariff margin pressure.
LULU.watch: March 25 earnings with full-year guidance; China expansion progress; gross margin under tariffs.

MPW.thesis: Raised quarterly dividend 12% to $0.09/share. Targeting $1B+ annualized cash rent by end-2026. But forward yield 6.45% signals market skepticism.
MPW.recent: Dividend raised 12%; rebranding to MPT with ticker change effective Feb 2, 2026.
MPW.risk: Healthcare tenant bankruptcies; elevated leverage and refinancing risk.
MPW.watch: Progress toward $1B+ rent target; tenant health and occupancy; balance sheet deleveraging.

COMP.thesis: Real estate tech platform with agent-centric model. Revenue tied to housing transaction volume. Rate cuts could catalyze recovery.
COMP.recent: Housing market showing early signs of recovery; agent count stabilizing.
COMP.risk: Housing market sensitivity to mortgage rates; competition from traditional brokerages; profitability elusive.
COMP.watch: Housing transaction volume recovery; agent productivity metrics; path to profitability.

LEG.thesis: Restructuring plan nearly complete with improved margins and reduced SG&A. 36.81% 90-day return. DCF suggests fair value ~$10.48.
LEG.recent: Share price $12.19 with strong recent return; Q4 FY2025 earnings Feb 11-12, 2026.
LEG.risk: Declining bedding and furniture markets; restructuring benefits may already be priced in.
LEG.watch: Feb 11-12 earnings for margin trajectory; normalized volume recovery; incremental earnings.

BTC.thesis: Institutional ETFs and corporate treasuries absorbing supply. Fed dovish expectations support store-of-value narrative. Some targets $150-225K, but near-term technically bearish.
BTC.recent: Trading $70-95K range in Feb 2026; bearish near-term technicals.
BTC.risk: Fed hawkishness; ETF outflows if risk assets normalize; regulatory crackdowns.
BTC.watch: Quarterly ETF inflows (target $10B+); Fed rate decisions; exchange balance declines as supply tightens.

ETH.thesis: Standard Chartered raised target to $7,500. Institutional ETF flows and staking reducing liquid supply. But underperforming Bitcoin in current cycle.
ETH.recent: Trading $2,000-2,500; ETFs acquired ~3.8% of all ETH since June.
ETH.risk: Layer-2 solutions cannibalizing L1 fees; competitive smart contract platforms; staking regulation.
ETH.watch: ETF inflows vs. BTC ETFs; network upgrades and DeFi TVL trends; corporate treasury adoption.

SOL.watch: ETF inflow sustainability; network uptime; stablecoin payment adoption on Solana.

XRP.thesis: Regulatory clarity post-SEC settlement. $1.37B flowed into XRP ETFs since Nov 2025 launch. Standard Chartered targets $8 by end-2026 (300%+ upside).
XRP.risk: Primarily a trading asset rather than payment utility; Ripple's ODL adoption slower than expected.
XRP.watch: ETF inflow momentum; Ripple institutional partnerships and ODL volumes; SWIFT integration.

ADA.risk: Development pace slower than competitors; DeFi ecosystem smaller than ETH/SOL; weak retail sentiment.
ADA.watch: CME futures volume; DeFi TVL growth and RWA tokenization; network upgrade timelines.

DOGE.thesis: REX-Osprey DOGE ETF launched Sept 2025. Experienced largest January inflows. Payment integration potential — but no fundamental utility.
DOGE.recent: Trading $0.09-0.12; full-year forecasts $0.15-1.25 depending on meme cycle.
DOGE.risk: No fundamental utility; entirely sentiment-driven; newer meme coins stealing attention.
DOGE.watch: ETF inflow trends; social media sentiment; payment adoption (Tesla accepting DOGE).

AVAX.thesis: RWA tokenization TVL $1.3B (68.6% growth Q4 2025) with BlackRock and FIS. VanEck ETF launched Jan 27 with early inflows. 4,500+ TPS throughput.
AVAX.recent: VanEck AVAX ETF launched Jan 27 with $1.24M net inflows by Jan 31.
AVAX.risk: RWA market could consolidate on fewer chains; Ethereum L2 competition; regulatory uncertainty.
AVAX.watch: ETF inflow growth; institutional RWA project announcements; subnet deployment metrics.

LINK.thesis: $27.4T total value secured. CCIP revolutionizing cross-chain interoperability. Neutral positioning benefits from multi-chain RWA adoption.
LINK.recent: Total value secured near $27.4T; CCIP enabling cross-chain value/data exchange.
LINK.risk: Competition from native bridge solutions; unclear token economics and value capture.
